name: Dual Point Map Insertion with Linear Probing
definition: Inserts a dual point into a hash map using linear probing to handle collisions, storing the point ID and index in a combined 64-bit key-value pair.
summary: Dual Point Map Insertion with Linear Probing efficiently stores geometric point IDs in a compact hash table using linear probing and 64-bit packing, distinguishing itself by explicit ID handling rather than spatial coordinates.
